description: SvNavPane in Svelte 5, an application sidebar with collapsible sections, items with icons and unread badges, nested folders, a single-select highlight and arrow-key navigation. A collapsed mode reduces it to an icon-only rail, and a bottom module strip with a drag splitter switches between modules such as Mail and Calendar; drag it up to collapse the modules into icons.

faq.question: How are sections and items defined?
faq.answer: sections is an array of { id, label, items } and each item has an id, label, optional icon, badge and children. value marks the selected item and onSelect reports clicks.

faq.question: What does collapsed do?
faq.answer: It narrows the pane to an icon rail with tooltips for the labels, keeping selection and keyboard navigation; the switch in the demo toggles it.

faq.question: How does the module strip work?
faq.answer: modules lists the bottom entries, moduleValue is the active one and bind:moduleRows tracks how many are shown as rows versus icons as the user drags the splitter.
